_meta.purpose: Per-standard fact rows that enrich /standards/[code] pages with revision/edition years, scope summaries, and acceptance/calibration specifics. Read by lib/content/standards-facts.ts.
schemaFields: keyClauses — most-cited sections with one-line summary
calibrationOrQualification — what must be qualified before use

asme-section-v.scope: Defines the NDE methods (RT, UT, MT, PT, ET, VT, LT, AE) used by every other ASME construction code; written-procedure + qualified-personnel framework.
asme-section-v.acceptanceCriteria: None — Section V contains *examination* requirements only; acceptance lives in the construction code (I, III, VIII, XI, B31.x) that invokes it.
asme-section-v.calibrationOrQualification: Procedure qualification per T-150; personnel qualified to a written practice (typically SNT-TC-1A or CP-189); equipment verified per the article's calibration table.
asme-section-v.typicalContractLanguage: All NDE shall be performed in accordance with ASME BPVC Section V, latest edition, with acceptance criteria per ASME Section VIII Division 1, UW-51.

asme-bpvc.scope: Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code — 13 sections covering construction, materials, welding, NDE, in-service inspection, and nuclear components.
keyClauses: Section XI — In-service Inspection of Nuclear Components
asme-bpvc.acceptanceCriteria: Each construction section publishes its own NDE acceptance tables (e.g. UW-51 in VIII Div 1 for full RT).
asme-bpvc.calibrationOrQualification: All welding procedures qualified per Section IX; all NDE per Section V with acceptance per the construction section.
asme-bpvc.typicalContractLanguage: Vessel shall be designed, fabricated, inspected and stamped in accordance with ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 1, latest edition + applicable addenda, U-stamped.

api-510.scope: In-service inspection, repair, alteration, and rerating of pressure vessels in the petroleum and chemical industries.
keyClauses: Sec. 5 — Inspection, Examination, and Pressure Testing
Sec. 7 — Inspection Data Evaluation, Analysis and Recording
api-510.acceptanceCriteria: Minimum thickness from original construction code (ASME VIII); fitness-for-service via API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 when below code minimum.
api-510.calibrationOrQualification: Authorised Pressure Vessel Inspector certified per API 510 (separate certification body — API ICP); supporting NDE personnel per ASME Section V.
api-510.typicalContractLanguage: Vessel inspection plan and intervals shall comply with API 510 11th edition; corrosion rates established per Sec. 7; FFS per API 579-1/ASME FFS-1.

api-570.scope: In-service inspection, repair, alteration, and rerating of metallic and FRP piping systems.
keyClauses: Sec. 6 — Frequency and Extent of Inspection
Sec. 7 — Inspection Data Evaluation, Analysis, Recording
api-570.acceptanceCriteria: Minimum thickness per ASME B31.3 calculation; circuit-based intervals per service-class table (Class 1/2/3/4).
api-570.calibrationOrQualification: API 570 Authorised Piping Inspector (separate ICP certification); supporting NDE per Section V.
api-570.typicalContractLanguage: Piping inspection per API 570 5th ed.; thickness monitoring per Sec. 5; circuit classification documented per Sec. 6.

api-653.scope: Tank inspection, repair, alteration, and reconstruction of aboveground welded steel storage tanks built to API 650.
api-653.acceptanceCriteria: Floor MFL + UT for sub-floor corrosion; shell UT-thickness vs API 653 minimum; settlement evaluation per Annex B.
api-653.calibrationOrQualification: API 653 Authorised Tank Inspector (ICP); MFL operators trained per ASNT SNT-TC-1A.
api-653.typicalContractLanguage: Internal tank inspection per API 653 5th ed., Sec. 6; floor MFL with UT confirmation; reconciliation report per Sec. 4.

api-1104.scope: Welding of pipelines and related facilities; covers procedure qualification, welder qualification, NDE, and acceptance criteria for cross-country girth welds.
keyClauses: Sec. 11 — Repair and Removal of Defects
api-1104.acceptanceCriteria: Sec. 9 tables for porosity, slag, undercut, cracks, lack of fusion/penetration; alternative criteria via Annex A (ECA).
api-1104.calibrationOrQualification: Welding procedures per Sec. 5; welders per Sec. 6; NDE personnel per ASNT SNT-TC-1A or equivalent.
api-1104.typicalContractLanguage: Girth welds shall be welded and inspected per API 1104 22nd ed.; AUT acceptance per Annex A (ECA) where applicable.

api-579.scope: Fitness-for-service assessment for in-service equipment with damage or deviations from new-construction code.
api-579.acceptanceCriteria: Three-level assessments: Level 1 (screening), Level 2 (closed-form), Level 3 (advanced FEA + fracture mechanics); RSF ≥ 0.9 typical pass.
api-579.calibrationOrQualification: Performed by qualified engineer (typically PE or chartered with FFS experience); inputs from API 510/570/653 inspection.
api-579.typicalContractLanguage: Indications exceeding code acceptance shall be evaluated per API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 prior to repair/disposition.

aws-d1-1.scope: Structural Welding Code — Steel; covers design, qualification, fabrication, inspection of welded steel structures (≥ 1/8 inch thick).
aws-d1-1.acceptanceCriteria: Cl. 6.12 tables — separate static vs cyclic; UT acceptance via Table 6.2 with dB rating system.
aws-d1-1.calibrationOrQualification: Welding personnel per Cl. 4; CWI inspectors per AWS QC1; NDE per AWS D1.1 + AWS QC1 / SNT-TC-1A.
aws-d1-1.typicalContractLanguage: All welding shall comply with AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2025; NDE per Cl. 6 with cyclically-loaded acceptance criteria; CWI present during fabrication.

aws-d1-5.scope: Bridge Welding Code — fracture-critical and non-fracture-critical members of steel highway bridges; co-published with AASHTO.
keyClauses: Cl. 12 — Fracture Control Plan (FCP) for FCM
aws-d1-5.acceptanceCriteria: Stricter than D1.1 — fracture-critical members require CVN-toughness-qualified WPS, RT/UT on every CJP weld, zero tolerance for cracks.
aws-d1-5.calibrationOrQualification: Welders per Cl. 5; NDE personnel per AWS QC1; fabricators must be AISC certified for major bridges in many jurisdictions.
aws-d1-5.typicalContractLanguage: All welding of fracture-critical members shall conform to AWS D1.5:2020 Cl. 12 Fracture Control Plan; 100% NDE; CVN-qualified procedures.

iso-9712.scope: Qualification and certification of NDT personnel — third-party certification scheme (vs employer-based SNT-TC-1A).
keyClauses: Annex A — Training hours by method/level
iso-9712.acceptanceCriteria: Pass each exam part ≥70%, composite ≥70%; vision Jaeger #1 or equivalent + colour annual.
iso-9712.calibrationOrQualification: Certification body must be accredited per ISO/IEC 17024; certificate held by individual, portable across employers.
iso-9712.typicalContractLanguage: All NDT personnel shall be certified to ISO 9712:2021, Level 2 minimum, in the relevant method and industrial sector.

iso-17636.scope: Radiographic testing of fusion welds — methods, IQI selection, exposure parameters, image quality classes A and B.
keyClauses: Sec. 7 — Image quality (with reference to ISO 19232)
iso-17636.acceptanceCriteria: None — references ISO 5817 (acceptance for steel welds) and ISO 10675-1 (RT acceptance).
iso-17636.calibrationOrQualification: Personnel per ISO 9712; equipment per ISO 11699 (film) or ISO 17636-2 detector classes.
iso-17636.typicalContractLanguage: RT shall be performed per ISO 17636-1:2022 Class B technique; acceptance per ISO 10675-1 Level B.

iso-13588.scope: Ultrasonic testing of welds — Use of automated phased array technology (PAUT).
iso-13588.acceptanceCriteria: References ISO 19285 (acceptance for PAUT) or contract-specific criteria.
iso-13588.calibrationOrQualification: PAUT-specific qualification per ISO 9712 or equivalent; focal-law verification on a representative test block.
relatedStandards: ASME Section V Article 4 Mandatory Appendix VIII
iso-13588.typicalContractLanguage: Encoded PAUT shall be performed per ISO 13588:2019 Testing Level B; acceptance per ISO 19285.

iso-3452.scope: Penetrant testing — general principles, products, equipment, technique.
iso-3452.acceptanceCriteria: References ISO 23277 (PT acceptance for welded joints) or product specification.
iso-3452.calibrationOrQualification: Personnel per ISO 9712; products controlled per ISO 3452-2 (testing materials); test blocks per ISO 3452-3.
iso-3452.typicalContractLanguage: PT shall be performed per ISO 3452-1:2021, sensitivity level 2; acceptance per ISO 23277 Level 2X.

iso-9934.scope: Magnetic particle testing — general principles, materials, equipment.
iso-9934.acceptanceCriteria: References ISO 23278 (MT acceptance for welded joints).
iso-9934.calibrationOrQualification: Personnel per ISO 9712; tangential field strength 2–6 kA/m verified per ISO 9934-3; reference blocks per ISO 9934-2.
iso-9934.typicalContractLanguage: MT shall be performed per ISO 9934-1:2016 with tangential field strength verified per ISO 9934-3; acceptance per ISO 23278 Level 2X.

asme-b31-3.scope: Process Piping — design, materials, fabrication, examination, and testing of piping in chemical, petroleum, and related processing plants.
keyClauses: Cl. 304 — Pressure design of piping components
asme-b31-3.acceptanceCriteria: Table 341.3.2 — acceptance criteria for welds by service category (Normal, Cat-D, Cat-M, Severe Cyclic).
asme-b31-3.calibrationOrQualification: Welding per ASME IX; NDE per ASME V; examiner per Owner's Inspector or qualified per Owner's program.
asme-b31-3.typicalContractLanguage: All process piping shall be designed, fabricated, inspected and tested per ASME B31.3-2024, Normal Fluid Service; examination per Cl. 341 Table 341.3.2.

astm-e1444.scope: Standard practice for magnetic particle testing — the U.S. companion to ASTM E709 (guide); E1444 is the *practice* (mandatory language).
astm-e1444.acceptanceCriteria: References the customer specification or governing code; E1444 is silent on accept/reject sizing.
astm-e1444.calibrationOrQualification: Yoke lift test (4.5 kg AC, 18 kg DC); ammeter ±10% per E709; QQI or pie gauge field-direction verification.
astm-e1444.typicalContractLanguage: MT shall be performed per ASTM E1444/E1444M-22, wet-fluorescent technique, with continuous magnetisation.

astm-e1417.scope: Standard practice for liquid penetrant testing — U.S. mandatory-language practice (vs E165 guide).
astm-e1417.acceptanceCriteria: References AMS 2647 (aerospace), customer spec, or governing construction code.
astm-e1417.calibrationOrQualification: Penetrant batch certified to AMS 2644; sensitivity verified on TAM panel; UV-A intensity ≥1000 µW/cm² @ 15 inch for fluorescent.
astm-e1417.typicalContractLanguage: PT shall be performed per ASTM E1417/E1417M-21, Type I (fluorescent) Method C (solvent removable), Sensitivity Level 3.

astm-e709.scope: Standard guide for magnetic particle testing — non-mandatory tutorial; companion to mandatory practice E1444.
keyClauses: Sec. 7 — Magnetisation methods (yoke, prods, central conductor, coil, multidirectional)
astm-e709.acceptanceCriteria: Not in E709 — guide only; acceptance from E1444 contract or governing code.
astm-e709.calibrationOrQualification: Refers to E1444 for mandatory equipment qualification.
astm-e709.typicalContractLanguage: MT inspector training shall reference ASTM E709 as background; mandatory examination per ASTM E1444.

astm-e94.scope: Standard guide for radiographic examination using industrial X-ray and gamma-ray sources; broad tutorial covering film and digital.
astm-e94.acceptanceCriteria: None — references E390/E1742 (film handling) and customer/code acceptance.
astm-e94.calibrationOrQualification: References ASTM E747 (wire IQI) and E1025 (plaque IQI) for image quality verification.
astm-e94.typicalContractLanguage: RT technique shall comply with ASTM E94, with image quality per ASTM E1025 essential hole 2T.

nace-mrt-01-72.scope: Materials for use in H2S-containing environments in oil and gas production — metallic materials selection and surface limits to avoid sulfide stress cracking (SSC).
keyClauses: Annex A — Environmental severity zones (SSC region 0/1/2/3)
nace-mrt-01-72.acceptanceCriteria: Material hardness limits (e.g. ≤ 250 HV / 22 HRC for carbon steels); environmental partial pressure limits.
nace-mrt-01-72.calibrationOrQualification: Hardness testing per ASTM E140 with traceable reference blocks; PMI per API 578.
nace-mrt-01-72.typicalContractLanguage: All materials in sour service shall conform to NACE MR0175/ISO 15156:2020 Part 2; hardness verified by PMI on receipt and post-PWHT.

asnt-cp-189.scope: Standard for qualification and certification of NDT personnel — the *standard* form of SNT-TC-1A's recommended practice (mandatory language, employer-based).
asnt-cp-189.acceptanceCriteria: Pass mark per part ≥ 70%, composite ≥ 80%; recertification 5-year cycle.
asnt-cp-189.calibrationOrQualification: Vision Jaeger #2 + colour annual; experience hours documented per Annex A; Level III via ASNT NDT Level III certificate.
asnt-cp-189.typicalContractLanguage: All NDT personnel shall be qualified and certified per ANSI/ASNT CP-189-2020, Level II minimum, in the applicable method.
